scope.mode: Focused independent review of continuation changes; full files read because these local additions lack a useful historical diff.

resolvedFindings.issue: Identity fingerprints covered the branch fingerprint only; changing reviewed name, address or evidence could leave an invalid mapping publicly attached.
resolvedFindings.minimalFix: Fingerprint the complete validated identity review and compare that exact review hash at runtime.
resolvedFindings.verification: Eight independent changes to reviewed name,address,independent URLs,place evidence,review time,status,branch fingerprint and place ID each strip the ID while retaining source menu rows and changing the public cache fingerprint.

resolvedFindings.issue: Picking the first review ignored conflicting duplicate branch or place-ID assignments.
resolvedFindings.minimalFix: Require exactly one branch review and globally unique use of the mapped place ID.
resolvedFindings.verification: Conflicting approved branch duplicate, withdrawn branch duplicate and duplicate ID on another branch each strip the ID and retain the menu.

resolvedFindings.issue: Same-instant outcome conflicts were compared by raw timestamp strings, permitting offset-format differences to silently choose a winner.
resolvedFindings.minimalFix: Normalize parsed dates to canonical ISO before comparing or storing them.
resolvedFindings.verification: 2026-10-16T00:00:00Z and2026-10-16T08:00:00+08:00 in different batches now conflict; an older outcome cannot overwrite a newer one.

checks.name: Explicit identity mapping boundary
checks.assessment: Stored-ID membership, unique IDs/branches, independent branch facts and separate branch fingerprint validation remain required. Complete-review hash now covers the public mapping authority.

checks.name: Compiler identity projection and drift
checks.method: Isolated actual compileEntry function invoked without runner main or file writes.
assertions: Reviewed map ID and full review fingerprint enter manifest review and output menu
A matching regenerated review passes check mode
ID change requires explicit publication review
Fingerprint-only identity change also requires explicit review

checks.name: Runtime changed and withdrawn identity handling
assertions: Invalid,withdrawn or ambiguous identity strips googlePlaceId
Public summary fingerprint changes when ID is removed
Raw source-packet mutation still withholds the affected menu

checks.name: Portion and preorder/option preservation
assertions: Unrecognized private/provider root fields omitted from normalized public item

checks.name: Frozen outcome validation and chronology
assertions: Unknown stored ID,invalid eligibility/menu/date/URL/text,duplicate ID and nonfrozen packet reject
Equivalent timestamp instants normalize and conflict
Older outcomes cannot overwrite newer ones
Only unresolved eligibility permits empty evidence URLs

checks.name: Actual coverage integration without publication promotion
checks.method: Actual frozen files and actual adapter applied to an in-memory directory with explicit identity reviews; no generated coverage files written.

checks.name: Native data boundary
checks.assessment: Identity review JSON and compiled research enter src only through server/menu-delivery and the server API. Outcome adapter imports are confined to scripts. Public menu parser emits whitelisted merchant facts and place IDs, excluding research review/provenance internals and owner/private/provider payload fields.

limitations: No Google or other outbound requests were made.
Identity and compiler mutation checks use isolated process memory; only this review artifact is written.
Static JSON identity changes take effect on server rebuild/reload, matching the existing static publication model.
Root is integrating data concurrently; this reviews the recorded code hashes and projection safeguards, not final collection completeness or new merchant transcription accuracy.
TypeScript,lint and end-to-end acceptance are handled by their separate final gates.
